fields.description: Name shown in lists. Defaults to the hostname.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Cluster whose mail this gateway sends.
fields.label: Cluster

fields.description: Set on first save, e.g. g1.blr.frappemail.com. Reverse DNS of the IP must point to it.
fields.label: Hostname

fields.description: Where the server runs, e.g. DigitalOcean BLR1. For information only.
fields.label: Location

fields.description: Clear to take the gateway out of service. Pools that use its addresses stop working.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Pending: not provisioned. Provisioning: a job runs. Provisioned: waits for its certificate and API key. Active: relays mail. Failed: see Last Error. Disabled: stopped by an operator.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Pending
Provisioning
Provisioned
Active
Failed
Disabled

fields.description: Stalwart release to run. Change it and run Upgrade.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: Stalwart release installed by the last job.
fields.label: Installed Version

fields.description: Why the last job, check or push failed.
fields.label: Last Error

fields.description: Public IPv4 of the server, used for SSH and management. Changing it requires a new SSH check.
fields.label: IPv4 Address

fields.description: Management URL of the gateway's Stalwart.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Blank uses the cluster SSH user.
fields.label: SSH User

fields.description: Blank uses the cluster SSH port.
fields.label: SSH Port

fields.description: Verify SSH reached the server. Required before Provision.
fields.label: SSH Verified

fields.description: Recorded on first SSH contact and checked on each connection. After a reinstall, run Reset SSH Host Keys.
fields.label: SSH Host Keys

fields.description: Store for the gateway's queue and settings. Blank creates a local RocksDB store.
fields.label: Data Store

fields.description: Generated on save.
fields.label: Admin Password

fields.description: Generated on save. The agent uses it to read Prometheus metrics.
fields.label: Metrics Password

fields.description: Token Suite Cloud uses to push configuration. Created when provisioning finishes.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: When the last provisioning or upgrade job succeeded.
fields.label: Provisioned At

fields.description: Increases on each configuration push.
fields.label: Config Version

fields.description: Last pushed configuration, secrets hidden.
fields.label: Config Plan
